name: @skein-js/example-deep-agent
description: A research briefing assistant built with LangChain Deep Agents and served by skein from an unchanged langgraph.json: it plans, delegates research to a subagent, drafts briefings into the conversation, remembers each user's preferences, asks before emailing, and runs deep dives in the background. Runs offline with a scripted model, or against a real model via DEEP_AGENT_MODEL.
